name: Founder Control Plane / Command Ops Runtime
purpose: Create the founder/operator command cockpit for Kingsmen: mobile-first oversight, command intake, command approval, escalation handling, daily briefs, watchlists, and command audit while preserving N12 governance and N16 orchestrator state control.
locked_laws: Founder Control Plane is a command cockpit, not a second backend.
Founder commands must route through N12 governance and N16 orchestrator.
Founder commands may not bypass the state machine.
Founder commands may not directly submit applications, approve refunds, decide fraud, alter privacy status, or fake official status.
Founder can inspect, prioritize, pause, resume, approve, reject, escalate, request MAP, request Phoenix fallback, and request human review.
Dangerous commands require approval boundary and evidence.
All founder decisions must write audit and evidence references.
Phone-friendly founder cockpit must show cause, reason, current risk, next action, and fix path.
Daily briefs must include system health, queue, finance, documents, matching, Playwright/MAP, incidents, cap, and urgent candidates.
Priority lane changes affect order and intensity only, not user dignity or national route access.
No silent override. No invisible command. No command without trace.
Candidate communication remains email-first; WhatsApp is urgent-only.
Founder control must respect Oracle Lite capacity and 500 active-candidate operating cap.
